description: Create a game in the signed-in workspace. Returns its client token (gl_pub_…, the public key game builds send with) and the intake URL to put in the game's Glitchless.init; the instrument skill says where for each engine. Later calls can name it with game. With demo: true it makes the demo game instead: Zoomies with a week of sample play (findings, levels, errors, sessions and a dashboard), for trying every tool before a real game sends data. A workspace has one demo game, and it takes no room from the plan's games.

demo.description: Make the demo game, with a week of sample play

game.description: The game, by name or id, when signed in to a workspace (glitchless_list_games lists them); later calls keep it. Ignored with a key for one game.

name.description: The game's name, as players know it (not needed with demo)

name: glitchless_create_game
title: Create game
